args.title: Juniper Labware — Warehouse automation in 2026
args.body:
• Juniper Labware’s latest newsletter highlights its new “Warehouse automation in 2026” analysis and links readers to the article and companion piece.
• The main article reports that autonomous carts increased pick rates by 18%, while integration took twice as long as planned.
• The companion piece says the largest cost saving came from reducing warehouse mis-picks.
